data.narrative:
Dawn Aerospace is a Series B-stage space and aerospace company that has raised $25M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private peers (Sierra Space at $8.0B, Cowboy Space Corporation at $2.0B, Varda Space Industries at $1.5B, Aalyria at $1.3B, and Skyryse at $1.1B) alongside five public Space & Aerospace comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL).

Two triangulation methods apply to the target. Stage-progression analysis uses the $25M total raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $48M. Peer-median valuation anchors to the $1.5B median across the five same-sector private peers, with observed range of $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring is not applicable; while the Space & Aerospace sector trades at a 26.4x median P/S across six public tickers, the target's revenue is not disclosed.

The two applicable methods produce a triangulated range of $40M (low) to $1.7B (high), with a median of $774M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty: the peer-median method is dominated by late-stage capital raises and outliers, while the stage-progression method reflects only fundraising history without operational performance. Key uncertainties include product-market validation, revenue trajectory, and whether Dawn's technology roadmap justifies the upper quartile of peer valuations.
